text:
maya: Quick profiling sweep across L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100 after selector v2 rollout. Short summary: small-seqlen chat (<=64) on L4/T4 is seeing ~15-30% p95 regressions. A100/H100 unchanged.

jin: can you paste the main numbers and what changed in the selector?

maya: p95 (batch=1, seqlen=32): L4 before=70ms -> after=94ms, A100 before=47ms -> after=49ms. Observed CPU-side memcpy wait increased ~110ms on L4. Perf counters show lots of PCIe memcpy stalls during KV cache fetch.

sam: sounds like the selector picked a fused kernel path that is great on H100/A100 but causes extra staging on Tegra-derived cards (L4/T4). Those kernels add interim memcpys.

ana: we did change the sequence-length crossover in PR b9c4d — cutoff moved 28->48. I thought device-family tagging prevented this on non-H100 devices, but a few L4 device IDs slipped through.

maya: repro snippet:
```
# repro minimal
redwood-run --device L4 --model gpt-medium --batch 1 --seqlen 32 --kernel-selector=policy_v2
# quick perf readout
memcpy_wait_ns: 110000000
kernel_launches: 20
kv_fetch_calls: 22
```

jin: two issues: (1) policy_v2 mislabels some L4 devices as H100-family, (2) the fused path is memory-bound for small sequences on low-memory cards.

sam: mitigation idea: add a runtime device-family override and an adaptive fallback rule: if memcpy_wait_ns > 50ms for the last N requests, bias selector to small-kernel path.

ana: drafted a device preset for Dedicated/Private pools:
```json
{
  "preset_name": "edge-smallseq-presets",
  "device_filters": ["L4","T4","A10-legacy"],
  "seqlen_cutoff": 36,
  "prefer_kernels": ["small_bmm","unfused_gemm"],
  "fallback_on_memcopy_ms": 50
}
```

perf-bot: perf/job/9023 finished: baseline vs policy_v2, L4 p95 delta +26% (regression).

sam: let's gate policy_v2 behind explicit canary pools for device families we validate. Also add a KV-copy metric to Console: avg_kv_copy_ms per token.

maya: validated rollback to policy_v1 on the same host — p95 returned to baseline. Plan: run a 24h canary applying ana's preset to dedicated L4/T4 pools, execute ~1k chat samples, collect avg_kv_copy_ms and memcpy_wait_ns, then decide. Add me to canary alerts.

ana: opening PR to add device-id mapping, the new preset, and a selector metric (PR #1521). CI queued.

jin: if PR passes, also add an autotune rule: if device_memory < 24GB AND median_seqlen <= 64, set seqlen_cutoff=32 and disable fused path by default. That should catch A10 variants.

sam: note: batching heuristics interact here. Ingress batching sometimes aggregates to batch=4 which masks the regression. Recommend per-route explicit batching override for "interactive-chat-smallseq" routes.

maya: I'll add a short runbook with transparent validation steps and rollback commands. Put me on canary notifications @maya.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: dedicated-l4-t4 pool, preset=edge-smallseq-presets, window=24h :rocket:

ana: PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/1521 (CI running).

maya: next actions: ship PR, start canary, refresh perf dashboards. If memcpy_wait_ns stays >50ms revert selector.v2. :thumbsup:
